subtopics.title: Transformer Block Architecture
subtopics.summary: The core building block of foundation models, including self-attention mechanisms and feed-forward layers that determine how the model processes and represents information.

subtopics.title: Model Capacity and Parameter Scaling
subtopics.summary: How the number of parameters, layers, and hidden dimensions affect model capacity, expressiveness, and the ability to learn complex patterns from data.

subtopics.title: Training Bottlenecks and Resource Constraints
subtopics.summary: Computational and memory limitations during training, including GPU memory, bandwidth, and the trade-offs between model size and training time.

subtopics.title: Inference Optimization Techniques
subtopics.summary: Methods for reducing inference latency and cost, such as quantization, caching, and API-based optimizations used in production deployments.
